title: Non-Deterministic Finite Automata for Telugu Letters and Visualizations for Metrical Poetry
abstract: arXiv:2611.18661v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Syllabic weight is central to Telugu metrical poetry. Syllabically, every letter (aksharam token) is either light (laghuvu) or heavy (guruvu). Poets classify it using a set of pre-defined rules. This paper formalizes aksharam token, the atomic unit of syllabic classification, as a non-deterministic finite automaton (NFA) with the regular expression$\colon$ $(A_h+A_d+A_p)(\epsilon+V_s)+A_m+H^+G(\epsilon+H+V_s+V_v)$, where $\epsilon$ denotes a null string, $A$ denotes a vowel (achchu), comprising hrasvam ($A_h$), deergham ($A_d$), plutham ($A_p$), and miscellaneous ($A_m$), $H$ a pure consonant (pollu\_hallu), $G$ a vowel diacritic (gunintha\_chihnam), $V_s$ the sunna (anusvara), and $V_v$ the visarga, the latter two being nasal and aspirated sounds respectively. We then present automata diagrams and regular expressions for (i) a necessary condition satisfied by every light letter, and (ii) a sufficient condition for a letter to be heavy.

translated_title: 泰卢固语字母的非确定性有限自动机及格律诗歌的可视化
translated_abstract: 音节轻重是泰卢固语格律诗歌的核心。从音节角度来看，每个字母（aksharam 记号）要么是轻音节，要么是重音节，诗人依据一组预定义的规则对其进行分类。本文将 aksharam 记号——即音节分类的原子单元——形式化为一个非确定性有限自动机（NFA），其正则表达式为：$(A_h+A_d+A_p)(\epsilon+V_s)+A_m+H^+G(\epsilon+H+V_s+V_v)$，其中 $\epsilon$ 表示空字符串，$A$ 表示元音，包括短元音、长元音、超长元音和杂项元音，$H$ 表示纯辅音，$G$ 表示元音附加符号，$V_s$ 表示鼻音符号，$V_v$ 表示送气符号，后两者分别对应鼻音和送气音。随后，我们给出了以下内容的自动机图和正则表达式：(i) 每个轻音节字母都满足的必要条件，以及 (ii) 字母成为重音节字母的充分条件。
tldr: 本文将泰卢固语格律诗歌中音节分类的原子单元 aksharam 形式化为非确定性有限自动机，并给出了轻音节字母的必要条件与重音节字母的充分条件的自动机图和正则表达式。
